verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, and a built-in assistant inside its console is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers developer building blocks: the chat completions API, tool use, remote MCP orchestration and the Responses API. These are primitives for building an agent, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
